target.title: refactor(deadcode): privatize banner and menu internals
target.body:
## What Problem This Solves

Follow-up to #105615: three newly added implementation-only exports had to be added to the Knip unused-export baseline to unblock PR CI. Keeping them allowlisted would preserve unnecessary production surface and leave permanent deadcode debt.

## Why This Change Was Made

- Keep `ClawBannerOptions` and `MenuSurface` private to their owner modules.
- Remove the banner's production-only `testing` export.
- Verify animated/static banner equivalence through the public `printClawBanner` path.
- Remove the three temporary baseline entries added by #105615.

These exports only existed on unreleased `main`; no shipped public contract is removed.

## User Impact

No runtime behavior change. The production export surface and deadcode baseline both shrink.

## Evidence

- Current head: `789a2aa86b95dccdd74330dd58e0db3febe03044`
- Blacksmith Testbox `tbx_01kxbvdbywd3nxffcxq2p7wgq2`
- `pnpm deadcode:exports` — baseline matched 6,012 entries
- `pnpm test src/cli/claw-banner.test.ts ui/src/components/menu-surface.test.ts` — 11/11 passed
- `pnpm check:changed` — passed all selected core, core-test, UI, and tooling gates
- Fresh autoreview — clean, confidence 0.96
- Exact-head CI: https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/actions/runs/29205435549
